notes: One row per team-game, INCLUDING every zero-candidate team-game, which carries n_candidates=0 and a named zero_candidate_reason. As-of bound derived from GAME DATES via asof_invariant.bound_from_dates (max(game_date) + 1 day at 12:00 UTC). The master's observed_time column is a LOCAL FILE MTIME and is deliberately NOT used as an as-of bound.
